source_title: Veteran Tamil actress Vatsala Rajagopal passes away at 93
source_excerpt: Veteran Tamil actress Vatsala Rajagopal, famous for her roles as a grandmother, has died at the age of 93. The actress, renowned for her natural acting skills on celluloid and television series, died in Chennai on October 30. Though Vatsala joined the world of movies at a later age, she went on to carve out a long and successful career for herself in the entertainment field. She was well-known for her acting skills in many popular Tamil movies like 'Roja', 'Sathi Leelavathi', 'Anniyan' and 'Mozhi'.Vatsala Rajagopal dies at 93 in Chennai, mortal remains kept at Pallavaram residenceAccording to a report by Filmibeat, Vatsala Rajagopal succumbed to age-related illnesses. Her mortal remains have been kept at her residence in Pallavaram, Chennai, for paying respects. Professionally, some of her performances have been noteworthy, especially her performances as warm and witty old women. Her contributions to Tamil movies and television have made her a known figure in every household of the state.Vatsala Rajagopal made her acting debut at 60 with Mani Ratnam's 'Roja'Born and raised in Thiruvananthapuram, Vatsala developed an interest in dance and theatre during her school days. After getting married, she moved to Chennai in 1953 and worked as a clerk in the Accountant General's office. Interestingly, filmmaker K Balachander was a senior officer at the same workplace. She later became involved with theatre and performed with Rasika Ranga, a drama group run by cartoonist Sridharan. Her stage performances eventually opened the doors to cinema. Mani Ratnam offered her a role in his 1992 film 'Roja', which marked her acting debut at around the age of 60. She played the grandmother of Madhoo's character in the film.Vatsala Rajagopal's memorable films and television careerAfter her acting debut, Vatsala has starred in more than 400 films and has acted alongside many leading actors as well as filmmakers. Her filmography includes films like 'Sathi Leelavathi', 'Rhythm', 'Winner', 'Anniyan', 'Pattiyal', 'Dhaam Dhoom', 'Mozhi' and 'Kalyana Samayal Saadham'. She even rose to popularity as an actor in the small screen via the serial 'Chithi', 'Anandham', 'Mundhanai Mudichu' and 'Vasantham'.
